relevance_note: TNFAIP3 appears only as a count among reclassified diagnoses in a 1,000-family exome cohort ("BRIP1 (n = 1), and TNFAIP3 (n = 1)"), with no individual-level detail (no label, sex, age, variant or feature).
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; no table transcription. TNFAIP3 is mentioned once, in Results/Reanalyses, as one molecular diagnosis from upward variant re-classification; no person, variant or phenotype is described, and the per-case supplementary tables (E1-E4) are not in the file, so individuals/variants/phenotype tables are empty. n_patients_reported = 1 is the only TNFAIP3 count the text gives (a reanalysis subset); the cohort total of TNFAIP3 diagnoses is not stated. cohort_size_as_stated uses the 1505 sequenced participants (1000 probands plus 505 relatives); the probands alone number 1000. The prior-report flag refers to non-TNFAIP3 participants (SASH3, NCKAP1L, PIK3CG). Internal inconsistency noted: reanalysis denominators switch between 22 and 21 ("5/21 (23.8%)" vs "22 new molecular diagnoses").
